Required Skills * Strong understanding of prompt engineering, LLM behaviour, conversational design, and structured testing. * Ability to translate business requirements into clear prompts, workflows, decision logic, and agent instructions. * Backend or full-stack experience with technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and REST APIs. * Experience with webhooks, third-party integrations, authentication, databases, logs, and production debugging. * Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers. * High ownership, attention to detail, speed, and testing discipline. ## Good to Have * Experience with AI agents, voice AI, telephony, WhatsApp Business APIs, CRM systems, or sales automation. * Experience evaluating LLM outputs, analysing transcripts, creating test cases, and reducing hallucinations or conversation failures. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS, Azure, Supabase, or PostgreSQL. * Previous experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, customer engineering, technical consulting, or B2B SaaS. ## They should be comfortable working with an existing application, understanding how it works, and progressively making it more efficient, scalable, and user-friendly. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Quickbase Application Management - Take ownership of the existing Quickbase application, including its tables, relationships, forms, reports, dashboards, and workflows. - Maintain and troubleshoot existing functionality, resolve issues, and ensure the application operates reliably. - Manage application enhancements, user access, permissions, and configuration changes. - Review the existing application architecture and identify opportunities to improve performance, usability, and maintainability. - Document application structure, business rules, workflows, and technical changes. ### 2. Application Enhancements and Development - Gather and translate business requirements into practical Quickbase solutions. - Develop new features, forms, reports, dashboards, automations, and workflows. - Improve existing business processes by reducing manual work and eliminating unnecessary steps. - Identify gaps in the current application and proactively recommend improvements. - Test enhancements, troubleshoot defects, and implement changes with minimal disruption to existing operations. ### 3. Python Development and Automation - Develop Python scripts and utilities to automate repetitive tasks and business processes. - Build integrations between Quickbase and other applications, APIs, databases, and data sources. - Use Python to perform data validation, transformation, reconciliation, and bulk data processing. - Develop custom functionality where Quickbase's native capabilities are insufficient or where an external service would be more effective. - Write maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code. ### 4. Integrations and Data Management - Work with Quickbase APIs and REST APIs to exchange data with external systems. - Design and maintain reliable data import, export, synchronization, and integration processes. - Monitor data quality, investigate discrepancies, and implement validation and error-handling mechanisms. - Ensure appropriate handling of credentials, access permissions, and sensitive business data. ### 5. Continuous Improvement - Work with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and improvement opportunities. - Evaluate whether a requirement is best addressed through Quickbase configuration, Python development, or integration with another system. - Recommend solutions that improve productivity, reduce errors, and support future business growth. - Maintain technical documentation and communicate progress, issues, and recommendations clearly. ## Required Qualifications - Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining applications using **Quickbase**. - Proficiency in **Python**, including writing scripts, working with data, debugging, and building automation. - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and API integrations. - Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and data relationships. - Experience troubleshooting existing applications and enhancing functionality without disrupting established workflows. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. - Good communication skills and the ability to work independently. ## Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Quickbase pipelines, formula fields, relationships, reports, and application administration. - Experience with Quickbase API integrations and advanced application customization. - Familiarity with SQL and database concepts. - Experience with Git or other version control systems. - Familiarity with cloud platforms, scheduled jobs, and automated deployments. - Experience with data analytics, reporting, workflow automation, or AI-enabled business applications. ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who takes ownership of the application and thinks beyond the immediate task. Someone who asks, "Can this process be made better?" rather than simply implementing the next requested change.
